standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the equivalence of (1) and (2) to the algebraic statement over normal local rings.

standard_prerequisites.name: The extension lemma for coherent modules with property S2 across a closed subset of codimension at least two, cited from the same chapter
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cited at proof lines 2280-2281 and again at 2300-2301
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies both directions linking S2 (equivalently sufficient depth outside a big open) with extendability of the restriction from the big open.

standard_prerequisites.name: Local rings of points outside a big open in an integral normal locally Noetherian scheme have depth at least two, and rings of dimension at most one there are fields or discrete valuation rings
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the depth and dimension statements that identify the complement of the maximal locally free open as being of codimension at least two.

standard_prerequisites.name: A finite locally free module is reflexive and, over a discrete valuation ring or a field, a torsion free module is free
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the easy inclusion (3) implies (1) and the freeness of the stalks at points of local dimension at most one.

core_obligations: Equivalence of (1) and (2): by the affine criterion for reflexivity this is the algebraic statement over normal local rings cited from the more-algebra chapter (proof lines 2272-2274).

From (3) to (1): for an open U as in (3) the cited criterion for normality gives depth at least two at every point outside U, and since a finite locally free module is reflexive the cited extension lemma produces reflexivity of F (proof lines 2275-2281).

From (1) to (3), first the freeness locus: take U maximal with F restricted to U finite locally free, so that (3)(b) holds by construction, and note that freeness of a stalk forces the point to lie in U (proof lines 2283-2288).

From (1) to (3), the codimension bound: if the local ring at a point has dimension at most one it is a field or a discrete valuation ring, where a torsion free module is free, so points outside U have local dimension at least two, which by the cited codimension statement is exactly condition (3)(a) (proof lines 2289-2298).

From (1) to (3), the extension condition: the normality criterion also gives depth at least two at points outside U, so the cited extension lemma yields the identification of F with the pushforward of its restriction to U, which is (3)(c) (proof lines 2298-2301).
proof_roadmap: Reduce the equivalence of the first two conditions to normal local rings (proof lines 2272-2274), then get (3) implies (1) from the codimension two extension mechanism (proof lines 2275-2281).

For (1) implies (3), take the maximal open where the module is finite locally free, show its complement has local dimension at least two and depth at least two, and conclude both the codimension and the extension conditions (proof lines 2283-2301).
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives three equivalent descriptions of reflexivity for a coherent module on an integral locally Noetherian normal scheme: reflexivity, torsion freeness together with property S2, and being the pushforward of a finite locally free restriction from an open whose complement has codimension at least two (statement lines 2254-2270). The counted proof is a genuine three-way organisation: it reduces the first equivalence to normal local rings by the affine criterion, derives the easy implication from the extension lemma and the depth of points outside a big open, and then constructs the big open as the maximal locus where the module is finite locally free, proving that its complement has local dimension at least two using that local rings of dimension at most one are fields or discrete valuation rings, and that the module extends across it because of depth at least two (proof lines 2272-2301). It is H2: the argument is complete in the counted span, with the cited inputs being standard criteria and the extension lemma.
